verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਦਾ ਕਰੈ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: karan kaaran samarath hai saadhasa(n)gat dhaa karai karaiaa|

en.bdb: All competent God Himself is the efficient as well as material cause of all but He does everything according to the will of the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਰੈ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਦਾ ਦੇਇ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: bharai bha(n)ddaar dhaataar hai saadhasa(n)gat dhaa dhei dhivaiaa|

en.bdb: The stores of that bestower are full but he gives according to the wishes of the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਰੂਪੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: paarabraham gur roop hoi saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh samaiaa|

en.bdb: That transcendental Brahm, by being the Guru, enrapts the holy congregation into the Word, shabad.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਭੋਗ ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਪਰੇ ਨ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: jag bhog jog dhiaan kar poojaa pare na dharasan paiaa|

en.bdb: His glimpse can not be had by performing of yajna, offering sweets, yoga, concentration, ritualistic worship and ablutions.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਿਉ ਪੁਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਿਤਾ ਖਾਇ ਪੈਨ੍ਹੈ ਪੈਨ੍ਹਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat piau put hoi dhitaa khai painhai painhaiaa|

en.bdb: Fellows in the holy congregation maintain father-son relationship with the Guru,

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰਬਾਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਘਰਬਾਰੀ ਸਿਖ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gharabaaree hoi varatiaa gharabaaree sikh pairee paiaa|

en.bdb: And whatever he gives to eat and put on, they eat and wear.
